page.overview:
What is Pluton?

Pluton is one of the three Ancient Weapons, alongside Poseidon and Uranus. Pluton is a highly advanced warship capable of mass destruction, labeled the . It was constructed long ago in the city of Water 7 in the Grand Line. The battleship is said to be capable of destroying whole islands in a single shot and is located deep beneath Mt. Fuji in Wano Country.

Pluton was first mentioned by Crocodile when he questioned Nefertari Cobra of its whereabouts. In the Water 7 Saga, its blueprints were an important item that served as the catalyst for the saga's events.

It is supposed to be a large warship of some kind. Both Franky and Iceburg were shocked when seeing the blueprints, wondering how a ship like Pluton could be built in the first place. In the words of Tom, who was considered the best shipwright in the world, it is the most monstrous ship ever made in the history of ship building. Not much else is known about it.

Pluton is the most powerful warship in the world. The battleship is said to be capable of destroying whole islands in a single shot. Whoever controlled the weapon had the potential to conquer the world and thus in the wrong hands it would be quite dangerous. Likewise, Pluton also had the ability to do much damage to the world. Furthermore, because the blueprints remained in existence even after the ship was built, whoever possessed the blueprints to the vessel would have the potential to build a fleet of vessels with the same destructive abilities as each other.
